about: Cesar Blanco's personal blend in the Blanco family's Liga Exclusiva de Familia pair, rolled by Plasencia in Nicaragua. It uses a Honduran-grown Connecticut Shade wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler.

about: The dark, full-strength cigar that founder Desiree Sylver first commissioned and that launched Drunk Chicken Cigars in 2019. It is rolled in the United States with a Mexican San Andres wrapper.
notes: Usually called DCO. Made at an undisclosed factory in Florida. The maker lists the Toro as both 6 x 52 and 6 x 54.

about: One of the five blends Drunk Chicken Cigars launched with in 2019, a medium-strength habano rolled in the United States. It has also been offered as a box-pressed robusto.

about: One of the five blends Drunk Chicken Cigars launched with in 2019, a thick-ring habano rolled in the United States. It began as a Gordo and a short 4 x 60 torpedo.

about: One of the five blends Drunk Chicken Cigars launched with in 2019, a medium habano with Dominican filler. It is rolled in the United States.
